A '''DTX detector satellite''' was a type of [[Sensor satellite|satellite]] capable of detecting energy sources. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a loose web-grid of sixteen DTX detector [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]]  [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the barren<ref name="Ando Project" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uridia]]. The satellites were controlled from [[Computer/Legends|workstation]] in the Imperial [[Aquaculture Facility]] on the moon's surface. Due to frequent malfunctions, disruptions to the network did not elicit a quick response from the Imperials monitoring the satellite [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="Ando Project" />

{{RPG|The Ando Project}}
During the war, a group of Rebels traveled to Uridia to investigated the Aquaculture Facility. They were able to bypassed the satellite network using the ''[[Gambit]]'', a [[Luxury 2800]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], by flying through a gap in the network's sensor coverage.<ref name="Ando Project" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
DTX detector satellites appeared in "[[The Ando Project]]," an adventure for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Chris Doyle]] and was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. During the adventure, players are able to destroy satellites&mdash;without triggering an alert at the base&mdash;in order to reduce the difficulty to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the ''Gambit'' through a gap in the network.<ref name="Ando Project" />
